description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the full OpenClaw agent creation workflow. (2) Create BOTH required directory trees: ~/.openclaw/workspace-agent-support/agent/ AND ~/.openclaw/agents/agent-support/agent/. (3) Copy ALL FIVE template files (IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, USER.md, AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md) from ~/.openclaw/skills/agent-creator/templates/ into the workspace — critically including AGENTS.md and MEMORY.md which the SKILL.md flags as commonly missed. (4) Create workspace-agent-support/agent/models.json with provider='anthropic' and modelId='claude-3-5-sonnet', and auth.json as a valid dict. (5) Update ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json in THREE places: add the new agent to agents.list with model.primary='anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet' (proprietary slash-separated format), add 'agent-support' to agentToAgent.allow without removing 'agent-main', AND configure the Feishu binding by adding an entry to bindings[] AND a corresponding entry under channels.accounts keyed by 'supportbot' containing appId, appSecret, and botName. The proprietary traps are: the agentToAgent.allow list (easily missed), the two-part Feishu config (bindings + channels.accounts), the specific 'provider/modelId' string format in agents.list, and the second agents/{agentId}/agent directory structure.
